checks.requirement: Professional Summary must be present.

checks.recommended_fix: Regenerate or repair resume_json.professional_summary.

checks.requirement: Education section must be present.
checks.explanation: Resume JSON has no Education entries.
checks.recommended_fix: Regenerate or restore profile-grounded education.

checks.requirement: Engineering Experience must be present.
checks.explanation: Resume JSON has no project/engineering experience entries.
checks.recommended_fix: Regenerate with capstone and engineering project evidence.

checks.requirement: Technical Skills must be present.
checks.explanation: Resume JSON has no technical skills.
checks.recommended_fix: Regenerate or restore profile-grounded technical skills.

checks.requirement: Resume must include capstone/Baldwin High School evidence.
checks.explanation: No capstone or Baldwin High School evidence was detected.
checks.recommended_fix: Include the flagship capstone project or verified Baldwin High School project evidence.

checks.requirement: Generated resume must not contain unresolved placeholders or template markers.
checks.explanation: Resume contains unresolved placeholder/schema/template text.
checks.recommended_fix: Regenerate or strip unresolved template markers before rendering.

checks.requirement: Generated resume must not exceed the approved one-page maximum.
checks.explanation: Generated resume exceeds approved one-page limit.
checks.recommended_fix: Trim excess coursework, lower-priority bullets, skills, or professional-development detail before rendering.

checks.requirement: Resume section headings should not duplicate.
checks.explanation: Duplicate section headings were detected.
checks.recommended_fix: Deduplicate generated resume sections before rendering.

checks.requirement: Technical Skills should include engineering keywords.
checks.explanation: Technical skills appear sparse or not engineering-oriented.
checks.recommended_fix: Include role-relevant engineering tools, methods, and standards.

checks.requirement: Job Search Assistant evidence should appear when profile contains it and generation uses it.
checks.explanation: Profile contains Job Search Assistant evidence but resume text does not.
checks.recommended_fix: Include Job Search Assistant when selected/relevant, framed as automation/data/workflow evidence.

checks.requirement: Capstone project should have supporting bullets.
checks.explanation: First engineering project has no supporting bullet evidence.
checks.recommended_fix: Add concise capstone/project bullets grounded in profile evidence.

checks.requirement: Resume should use available page capacity reasonably.
checks.explanation: Resume appears short for a one-page target.
checks.recommended_fix: Consider adding relevant coursework, skills, or project detail if space allows.

checks.requirement: Cover letter must include a date.
checks.explanation: No rendered date was detected in the cover letter.
checks.recommended_fix: Render the cover letter with a date before upload/output.

checks.requirement: Cover letter must include employer name when available.
checks.explanation: Target employer name was not detected in the cover letter.
checks.recommended_fix: Render the company/employer block and include role/company specificity.

checks.requirement: Cover letter greeting must be present.
checks.explanation: Cover letter salutation is missing.
checks.recommended_fix: Use a verified named greeting or Dear Hiring Manager.

checks.requirement: Cover letter must use multiple body paragraphs.

checks.requirement: Cover letter architecture requires 3 body paragraphs by default.
checks.explanation: Cover letter has fewer than 3 body paragraphs.
checks.recommended_fix: Regenerate with role/company, engineering evidence, and leadership/automation paragraphs.

checks.requirement: Cover letter must include engineering evidence.
checks.explanation: No engineering/project evidence was detected.
checks.recommended_fix: Include capstone, coursework, technical tools, or engineering project evidence.

checks.requirement: Cover letter must include capstone or equivalent flagship evidence.
checks.explanation: No capstone/equivalent flagship evidence was detected.
checks.recommended_fix: Mention capstone or another verified flagship engineering project.

checks.requirement: Cover letter closing must be present.

checks.recommended_fix: Use a distinct professional closing such as Sincerely,.

checks.requirement: Cover letter signature must be present.
checks.explanation: Candidate signature is missing.
checks.recommended_fix: Include James Morseman on a separate signature line.

checks.requirement: Closing and signature must be separated from body text.

checks.requirement: Generated cover letter must not contain unresolved placeholders or template markers.

checks.requirement: Cover-letter header should include stable contact information.
